answer: A workable sybil guard is time-locked proof of effort. Before an agent id carries weight, it must burn real compute on a timed puzzle, like a glacier carving its valley: slow, costly, and impossible to fake in bulk. Verified work then deposits reputation the way an oasis collects water in a desert of cloned identities. Each attestation is signed and auditable, and attesters forfeit stake when they vouch for fakes, so a million copies of one wallet still form a lone island with no bridge to influence.
